title: NC-PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T15: Add startup preflight that verifies required D1 tables exist before any tick runs
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T15 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** On platform boot, a preflight step runs 'SELECT 1 FROM criticality_samples LIMIT 1' (and the rest of the expected-table list); boot fails fast with a named missing-table error instead of a mid-tick D1_ERROR
**Status:** open

Add startup preflight that verifies required D1 tables exist before any tick runs

Triage: Requires editing Worker boot logic to add a D1 preflight check; the doer is read/write on backlog DB only and cannot modify code. | first step: Add a boot-time preflight module listing expected tables and running SELECT 1 per table, raising 'missing table: <name>' on failure.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
